CC Switch source attribution

The model picker selection, filtering and context formatting in ui/manager.html
are adapted from src/components/providers/forms/FetchedModelPicker.tsx. The
same-origin model-list endpoint and catalog-ID rules in
cc_switch_model_discovery.py are adapted from src-tauri/src/services/model_fetch.rs.
The model metadata matching in cc_switch_metadata.py and public reference URL
in cc_switch_reference.py are adapted from src/lib/modelMetadata.ts and
src/lib/modelsDev.ts.
